# PETER PAN ON ICE – THE ICE SHOW

### Share

## About

For the first time at the Rabat Ice Rink, the ice transforms into a live stage!

The International Ice Stars present Peter Pan on Ice, a spectacular international ice show for the whole family.

Fly away to Neverland alongside Peter Pan, Wendy, Tinker Bell, and their friends, and embark on a magical adventure filled with humor and emotion.

Spectacular jumps, acrobatic lifts, mesmerizing choreography, and enchanting costumes: the world-renowned skaters of the International Ice Stars bring this classic tale to life like you have never seen before.

A show designed to delight children, while enchanting parents and grandparents alike. Young and old, come share an unforgettable family moment!

Multiple performances are scheduled throughout the weekend—choose the time that suits you best.

### PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Dates: November 26 to 29, 2026

Venue: Rabat Ice Rink (Patinoire de Rabat)

Show: Peter Pan on Ice

Seating: Open seating (free placement)

### PERFORMANCE SCHEDULE

Thursday, November 26: 7:00 PM

Friday, November 27: 3:00 PM and 8:00 PM

Saturday, November 28: 12:00 PM and 5:00 PM

Sunday, Novemb
